title: Functional long-term results after pelvic/acetabular fractures and lower limb injuries
summary:
The aim of the study is to investigate long-term changes in gait after fractures of the pelvis/acetabulum and after injuries to the lower extremity using treadmill analyses. Long-term results on gait changes after pelvic/acetabular fractures and after lower limb injuries are not yet available, but would be important for therapy decisions and guidelines. 
Patients treated at Saarland University Hospital are included in the study.
conditions: Fracture of lumbar spine and pelvis

interventions.name: Patients with pelvic/acetabular fractures and injuries to the lower extremities are examined using treadmill analysis 5-15 years after trauma in order to analyse possible long-term changes in gait during the healing process. criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Adult patients capable of giving consent with surgically or conservatively treated fractures S32.- /S72.-/S92.- Written information about the study and the patient's written consent must be available.
Exclusion criteria:
Underage. Lack of capacity to consent. Existing pregnancy. Imprisoned persons.
